articles.headline: Spain at the men's World Cup: All-time results and stats
articles.description: Take a look at the Spain men's national team's performance throughout the tournament's history.

articles.headline: Spain are cruising their way to the FIFA World Cup final
articles.description: Goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro, put Spain in a commanding position over France to make their first FIFA World Cup final since they won it in 2010.

articles.headline: Spain upset favorites France to reach World Cup final
articles.description: Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro gave Spain a 2-0 win over France in the first semifinal of the World Cup.

articles.headline: Spain's win vs. France ends incredible World Cup final streak
articles.description: For the last 11 World Cup finals, both Bayern Munich and Inter Milan had been represented. But that amazing streak is now over for one of those clubs.

articles.headline: Spain shut down France to advance to World Cup final
articles.description: Spain beat France 2-0 in their FIFA World Cup semifinal in Arlington, Texas, on Tuesday to make it three wins in a row against their European heavyweight rival.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Spain score twice to defeat France, become first finalist
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the 2026 World Cup as we saw Spain defeat France to become the tournament's first finalist.
